name: sklearn_generic
label: Sklearn Generic (Any Estimator)
brief: Train any scikit-learn estimator with automatic hyperparameter tuning and preprocessing. Supports SVM, KNN, Decision Trees, Gradient Boosting, AdaBoost, Extra Trees, MLP, Ridge, Lasso, ElasticNet, and more.
when_to_use: Any scikit-learn model for classification or regression
SVM for high-dimensional or small datasets
Gradient Boosting for high-accuracy tabular data
Decision Trees for simple interpretable models
When you want automatic hyperparameter tuning via cross-validation
when_not_to_use: Survival Analysis — use the survival_analysis skill (if available)
GLM with Poisson/Gamma/Tweedie distributions — use the glm skill (if available)
